decisions.capability: Maintain useful scoped memory across native Codex and Claude
decisions.evidence_scope: Nine current repository sources reviewed; native learning, scheduler admission, unchanged upstream tests and real client outcome capture are recorded separately. Existing code/document/context retrieval remain complementary layers.
limitations: Scheduler covers all store scopes, with a per-project limit and once-per-session claims; current deployment has one adopted project.
Assistant excerpts are sanitized and capped, not complete transcripts. Claude prompt capture remains opted out.
Model review rejected insufficient evidence; scheduler admission did not establish learned-write quality. Exact memory lifetime token savings remain unknown.
Alternative systems are research candidates, not installed or locally benchmarked winners.
decisions.next_gap: Evaluate real subsequent learned proposals and representative retrieval quality before changing the accepted memory of record.

decisions.capability: Resolve persistent native command and MCP environments
decisions.evidence_scope: Fresh native processes resolved selected commands/MCP servers and Claude startup hooks; restarted Desktop source retrieval has its own dated receipt.
limitations: Configuration presence does not prove an already-running task hot-reloaded it.
The Linux/WSL and Desktop process/configuration boundaries remain distinct.
decisions.next_gap: Collect the specific new-host or changed-session activation evidence; do not copy account stores.

decisions.capability: Restore selected native state into an isolated empty target
decisions.evidence_scope: Selected public bytes, native memory/FTS state and Qdrant snapshot/query results survived same-host backup/restore; synthetic wrong-key/corrupt-copy refusals were retained.
limitations: Independent physical host, lost-key recovery and the whole stack after disaster remain unestablished.
Financial-blueprint location supplies reusable state-recovery evidence only.
decisions.next_gap: Reuse the separate synthetic-offhost-application-restore acceptance for matching inputs; qualify production activation, native-client rebinding and lost-account/key recovery separately.

decisions.capability: Persist and retrieve approved cross-client project memory
decisions.evidence_scope: Scoped native retrieval, lifecycle negatives, migration, restart, upstream backup and empty-target restore have distinct accepted receipts.
limitations: Lifecycle capture is bounded sanitized observations, not complete transcripts.
Synthetic maintenance and production activation differ; TTL observations are not immediate access revocation.
decisions.next_gap: Reuse the separate synthetic-offhost-application-restore acceptance for matching inputs; qualify production activation, native-client rebinding and lost-account/key recovery separately.

decisions.capability: Restore selected native memory and vector state on a fresh hosted destination
decisions.evidence_scope: Two fresh hosted jobs passed native ai-memory and Qdrant backup, exact encrypted transfer and empty-target restore with actual scoped memory queries and complete Qdrant state/query equality. Independent review reconciled raw command outputs, artifact identities and cleanup.
limitations: New synthetic state only; no existing private application archive or production data was transferred.
Selected unchanged upstream tests passed (10 ai-memory and 4 Qdrant); the cross-host driver, observation oracle and composed restore checks are local integration coverage.
Source and destination are different hosted boot identities within one GitHub administrative domain; lost-account/password recovery and independent trust-domain availability remain unqualified.
Snapshots are sequential, not an atomic cross-application backup; native-client rebinding, physical-host or power-loss recovery and whole-stack acceptance are not established.

Actual destination MCP responses and Qdrant API responses were independently reviewed. Destination SQLite equality remains the runner composition assertion; archive SQLite integrity was separately checked.
No model calls or provider/lifetime token-saving measurement occurred.
decisions.next_gap: Qualify the actual deployment, native-client rebinding and application consistency requirements only when adopting beyond the accepted synthetic boundary.

existing_overturn_when: An isolated representative corpus and question set shows better source-grounded recall/usefulness and acceptable complete provider use, latency, capture/deletion and restore behavior without ambiguous memory ownership.
limitations: Scheduler admission does not establish learned-write quality; the retained model review rejected insufficient evidence.
Bounded sanitized assistant excerpts are not complete transcripts, and exact lifetime memory token savings are unknown.

Current primary-source review corrects manual-only, Claude-only and cloud-only exclusions. No matched memory benchmark or new installation was run; automatic capture, local providers and published scores remain source claims until exercised on the selected profile.
requirement: Keep scoped decisions, handoffs and useful learning available across native Codex and Claude with inspectable capture, deletion and recovery.
rules: Judge from retained evidence. Open the evidence_refs of every adopted candidate (bounded: the referenced file or its relevant section) and record every path you opened in sources_read. Do not rely on memory of the repositories.

The winner set is 1-3 adopted candidates (adopted == true) that best satisfy the requirement on the evidence. why_selected must cite at least one evidence path and state what was actually observed (native execution, measured comparison, local integration, synthetic fixture or source review), not what the project claims.
Every adopted non-winner candidate appears in alternatives with a why_not_default that states the concrete evidence gap or trade-off; add non-adopted candidates only with the same standard.

If a non-adopted candidate would satisfy the requirement better on the evidence, do not select it: record it in challenger_preferred with the comparison (a fixtures/, blueprints/ or tests/ path, or a python3/node command) that would establish it. Agreement between lanes never promotes; only an executed comparison can.

overturn_when names the concrete check that would change the verdict (a fixtures/, blueprints/ or tests/ path or a runnable python3/node command). open_gaps lists what the evidence does not establish. limits lists what you could not read or verify. Do not invent paths, numbers or results; leave evidence_refs empty rather than guess.
title: Durable memory
